crownRepair.scope: Private school-uniform crown occlusion repair; original artwork, rights records and rejected evidence preserved.
crownRepair.method: Each own 1280-square master is Lanczos-scaled to native 1024-square. Exact own-source RGBA fills only reviewed crown-mask pixels whose alpha exceeds the existing front-hair alpha. No new generation or transplanted pose pixels.
crownRepair.retainedExactly: All other native layer PNGs, clipping metadata, every motion JSON and every overrides JSON.
crownRepair.supersedes: Original revision 25 visual acceptance is rejected for a crown skin wedge confirmed by the user screenshot and direct source/layer/native comparison.
crownRepair.reviewAtCreation: Pending exact corrected-pack native validation, fixed-time, expression and physics-enabled playback inspection.

prompts.identityCorrect: <image1> is the selected Rubelia pose's own head crop. <image2> is the current-authority head crop and supplies face identity ONLY, not garments, body, hair replacement or a donor pose. If a separately reviewed face correction is ever requested, redraw ONLY the adult face inside {faceEditRect} to preserve her established face structure, green eyes and natural expression. Leave every pixel outside this rectangle untouched: keep the pose's head tilt, red/auburn hair, existing hair ornament, opaque navy jacket, white blouse, crimson necktie, pleated skirt, hands and thigh-up framing. The selected candidate is already accepted; do not run a new correction as a prerequisite.
prompts.pose: Create ONE complete 1280x1280 illustration of the SAME ADULT Rubelia in a genuinely different whole-body pose from <image1>. <image1> is the selected academy-uniform waiting illustration and defines her accepted adult face, long red/auburn hair, green eyes, existing hair ornament, illustration style and wardrobe. <image2> is a crop of that SAME selected image's head and supplies face identity ONLY, never garments or an entire face to transplant. Keep the unusually large head including all hair and ornament, full upper body, BOTH complete hands and upper thighs inside the square; preserve thigh-up framing across poses. Fully opaque tailored dark-navy jacket over an opaque white collared blouse, neat crimson necktie or ribbon, modest crimson-and-navy pleated skirt, restrained gold trim and buttons. Both eyes visibly OPEN, including in bored, happy and head-pet; hands never obscure face or either eye. Pose intent: {intent}. A single adult character, plain opaque white background; NO book, pen, fire, props, new accessories, text, logos, transparency, revealing garments, extra faces, extra limbs or panels.

poseIntents.writing: Focused working posture with a slightly downward gaze, both eyes open and both hands near waist height as a writing-like gesture without a pen or any prop; complete hands visible.
poseIntents.failed: Restrained concern and disappointment after a failed task; tilt the head down slightly while keeping both eyes open and the face fully visible, with a distinct hesitant hand gesture.
poseIntents.cancelled: A gentle resigned acknowledgment of an interrupted task; one small stopping gesture at chest height, other hand fully visible, both eyes open and no hands across the face.
poseIntents.disconnected: Puzzled by a lost connection; a small head tilt and one questioning palm-up gesture below the face. The OPPOSITE arm extends naturally down beside the body with its WHOLE hand and all fingertips clearly visible IN FRONT of or beside the skirt. BOTH distinct complete hands MUST be visible, never behind the back, inside pockets or occluded by the torso. Both green eyes OPEN and fully visible.
poseIntents.bored: Quiet prolonged-idle fidget and subtly shifted weight; a subdued sleepy-looking expression but BOTH eyes fully OPEN and visible, no face-touching hands.
poseIntents.happy: Warm satisfied open-eyed smile and buoyant posture; one hand held near the chest below the chin and the other clearly visible, both eyes OPEN, no face obstruction.
poseIntents.head-tap: Brief shy surprise from a tap on the head; head tilts distinctly and one hand lifts alongside the hair without crossing or covering either open eye, face or ornament.
poseIntents.torso-tap: Mild playful surprise at a tap on the torso; a distinct small body recoil and open-hand gesture at chest/side level, both open eyes and full face visible, unlike the head-tap pose.
poseIntents.head-pet: Content gentle OPEN-EYED smile while responding to an extended head stroke; a soft sustained lean and both complete hands below or beside the head, neither hand obscuring either eye or face; distinct from a brief tap.

prompts.expression: Edit <image1> into EXACTLY TWO EQUAL side-by-side panels of THIS SAME POSE'S OWN FACE. <image2> is a crop of this very pose's own head and is reference only: never substitute another pose's face, features, hair or clothing. Match the pose's adult Rubelia face, green irises, red/auburn hair, hair ornament, scale and camera angle in BOTH panels. LEFT: BOTH eyes completely CLOSED with natural continuous dark lashes and a SMALL OPEN MOUTH. RIGHT: BOTH eyes OPEN with intact green irises and a gentle natural smile. Keep face, brows, hair and ornament registered consistently; no third panel, extra faces, props, writing or labels.
